grammar_points.explanation: When you do something to a noun, like when you eat something or drink something, put を (o) after the thing that receives the action.

cultural_notes.title: Cultural Note
cultural_notes.content: When saying what color something is in Japanese, we need to remember a few things! If the words end in 色 (which actually means color!), like オレンジ色, put a の between the color and the thing!

cultural_notes.content: If the color comes after the thing it describes, の isn’t necessary.

grammar_points.explanation: If you want to ask someone out to dinner in Japanese, you need to know how to say the date!  For months, say the number of the month (for example, October is the 10th month) followed by 月. Then for the day, say the number followed by 日!

今日は二月二日です。
六月六日は何曜日ですか？
